statements.t: • We are excited to announce we have strategic acquisitions under contract or letter of intent representing more than $14 million in annual revenue, with closings anticipated for later this year and in early 2027; and

Carlos Quezada, Vice Chairman and CEO, stated, “We are encouraged by the continued momentum in our funeral business, with same-store funeral contracts increasing 2.3% during the quarter as we close the gap from a slower-than-expected first half.

Our operational review identified opportunities to strengthen fundamental sales disciplines, and since the beginning of the third quarter, we have taken targeted actions to reinforce our sales organization and restore the consistent performance we have delivered for over five years.

As previously communicated, we anticipated significant activity in the second half of the year, and today we have over $14 million in annual revenue represented by acquisitions under contract and letters of intent, with anticipated closings later this year and in early 2027.

Guided by our 2030 Vision and The Carriage Way, we remain confident in our people, our strategy, and our ability to deliver sustainable growth, stronger financial performance, and meaningful long-term value for our shareholders,” concluded Mr.

We are revising our full-year expectations to reflect the year-to-date results, including lower-than-anticipated mortality rates during the first half of the year, weaker cemetery preneed performance, ad ditional trust taxes recognized in connection with the sale of certain MLP investments, and revised timing of certain expected acquisitions.

While the improvement in our funeral business during the third quarter is encouraging, our updated outlook reflects the financial performance achieved to date and our current assessment of the fourth quarter.
An audio archive of the call will be available on demand via the Company's website at www.carriageservices.com.
